name: Order Sample Compression of the Three-Code Class
proof: Order the decoded hypotheses as $000<011<101$.  A sample whose least compatible hypothesis is $000$ needs no retained example.  If its least compatible hypothesis is $011$, the sample must exclude $000$, so retaining $x_0=1$ excludes the only earlier hypothesis.  If it is $101$, the sample must exclude both earlier hypotheses, and retaining $x_2=1$ does so.  Thus this is an order scheme of size one.  Size zero is impossible because one fixed reconstruction cannot be consistent with the distinct full samples $000$ and $011$.
